items.title: TC0100SCN text origin and flip
items.detail: Normal text source X uses the evidence-backed +16 origin. Validate flipped text independently against title, HUD and end-state checkpoints.

items.title: Radar and HUD regression
items.detail: Compare radar position, brake lamps, turbo indicators and end-state HUD across canonical Stage 1 driving and end-level checkpoints.

items.title: Sprite 4bpp shadow/compare
items.detail: Add an independent SHADOW/COMPARE path for the native sprite 4bpp decoder; require exact sprite ownership and pixel parity before any verified claim.

items.title: End-results transition
items.detail: Post-defeat chain is behavior-understood: 0x1002D0 minimum delay -> 0x1002C8 readiness -> 0x1002CE completion handoff -> results worker -> 0x100248 -> 0x1002E8 intermission gate.

items.title: Target health / damage
items.detail: CPU-A 0x1002AE is the special target remaining-hit counter. PC 0xA112 decrements on genuine damaging hits; FFFF is the terminal sentinel and PC 0xA118 enters defeat. Preferred causal checkpoint: stage1-target-immediate-pre-damage-6333.

items.title: Brake-lamp mechanism
items.detail: Processed brake at CPU-A 0x100303 feeds the 0x497E..0x49A8 palette path; banks 64/65 pen 13 switch to 0x18DE while braking and restore to 0x000E.

items.title: Stage 1 course graph / minimap
items.detail: Fork choice and selector lifecycle are behavior-understood. Convert proven selector 0-9 transition tables and lateral branch rule into an authoritative directed course graph/minimap.

items.title: Audio / sound CPU
items.detail: Perform a dedicated audio/device communication diagnostic pass after core gameplay controls are mapped.
